title: LLM-serving
description: vLLM + transformers serving stack with an NVIDIA GPU. flash-attn is optional and gated on a CUDA build toolchain (nvcc), exactly as the engine's FlashAttention installer checks.

packages.name: torch
packages.note: wheel auto-matched to CUDA (cuXXX) when a GPU is detected

packages.name: flash-attn
packages.note: optional · source build needs the NVIDIA toolchain (nvcc) matching torch's CUDA

postNotes: flash-attn is unchecked by default — enabling it requires nvcc on PATH matching torch's CUDA version.
